children: U.S. printed business product supplier's Q2 revenue grew 3.3% yr/yr
Q2 EPS declined yr/yr, mainly due to litigation-related items
Company raised quarterly dividend by 5% after strong operating quarter
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods in the press release
LITIGATION IMPACT - Decrease in EPS was mainly due to prior-year favorable litigation judgment and a current-quarter litigation charge
ACQUISITIONS - Acquisitions completed during the year contributed $2.3 mln in revenue and a $0.01 increase in diluted EPS for the quarter
HIGHER PAPER COSTS - Gross margin declined due to higher carbonless paper costs recognized in cost of sales
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the commercial printing services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ennis Inc is $24.00, about 12.6% above its September 18 closing price of $21.32
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
